_note: THE OUTFIT, LINK 2 of 2 (finale). Spec: home-office office/projects/delves/chains.md; combat family.
THE PLAYER'S PART: he calls them in himself. The slate said 'Bring the rest here'; the beacon is how they would be called, and switching it on is his choice to spring the trap. Then he holds.
CAUSE (rule 2): the slate off the gang at MB76a. SHAPE (rule 1): MB76a was a clear; this is use then hold.
CUT from chains.md's three links (derelict, boss, schematic): none of those is a part before the 19th. Pay: hard (rule 6).

FRANCES 2026-11-10 (reviews/2026-11-10-delve-MB108a.md): ship, findings 1-4 taken, 5 and 6 kept (chain-only, so no card; no count spoken). Forced pick answered NO: the choice is WHEN, not whether, so 'Your call.' became 'when you're ready', and 'You called them in yourself' pays it.

LEVEL AND DISTANCE 2026-11-11 (his: 'some quests shouldnt be given to a level 1 player' and 'not sending them across the whole map just to deliver a coffee'; Eliza's minLevel and place.parsecs, FrankyCLI 3c81f6a): minLevel 10: the chain finale, three waves of the outfit; parsecs 20: a hard job may fly further.
